name: Cloudflare DNS
description: Publishes ACME DNS-01 records through Cloudflare's DNS API, so apitorrent can get certificates (wildcards too) for names whose zone is on Cloudflare. Give it an API token limited to the zone, with Zone > DNS > Edit and Zone > Zone > Read, and start the daemon with --acme-challenge dns-01 --acme-dns-plugin cloudflare-dns.
author: apitorrent

apiToken.title: API token (Zone > DNS > Edit and Zone > Zone > Read, for this zone only)

zoneId.title: Zone ID (leave empty to find the zone from the name)

ttl.title: TTL of the records, in seconds

apiBase.title: API address (change it only to test against a mock)
